chunks: "If you pray with them, you will be forgiven according to the number of those who oppose you."

key_terms.اَلصَّادِقُ: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq عليه السلام, the speaker of the hadith
key_terms.بِعَدَدِ: in proportion to the number of
key_terms.خَالَفَكَ: those who opposed or differed from you
key_terms.مَعَهُمْ: with them, in their company or congregation

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for praying with those who differ from you according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teaches that praying with them brings immense forgiveness as a divine reward. The hadith highlights the spiritual merit connected with participation in congregational prayer in a context of difference or opposition.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1213 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"If you pray with them, you will be forgiven to the extent of the number of those who oppose you."
